panels.beat: The Ember Vault drops beneath one chain bridge; Elian and Mira are small adult silhouettes crossing toward the sealed bell lift.
One orange pulse travels upward through the chain and lifts dust against gravity.
Elian finds a bright straight shear face inside otherwise old rounded bridge wear.
Elian watches the sealed lift while his weak starting state is shown in reserved negative space.

lettering_units.text: ELIAN VOSS · LV 3 · XP 60 / 100 · SALVAGER · BREATH SEED I · HP 44 / 52 · QI 31 / 40

panels.beat: Mira asks whether the shear is old; Elian identifies it as a clean opening.

lettering_units.text: Tell me the bright edge is old.

panels.beat: Mira confirms that Elian still has both Iron Seals as his thumb moves toward them.
The bridge drops half a link; Mira catches the rail and Elian catches her spear shaft in a practiced response.
They release each other's gear; the intact Spark Talisman blinks behind two untouched Iron Seals.

lettering_units.text: The lift is across. We move before it sings twice.

panels.beat: Belljaw Warden climbs onto the far platform and opens the orange seam of its bell-shaped jaw.
The Level 6 custodian fills the bridge mouth while a narrow threat plate identifies its load response.

lettering_units.text: BELLJAW WARDEN · LV 6 · EMBER VAULT BRIDGE CUSTODIAN · VERIFIED TRAIT: LOAD RESPONSE

panels.beat: Elian tracks jaw, shoulder, forefeet, and anchor while visibly holding his breath.
Belljaw is right, Mira center-left, Elian behind, intact anchor below-left, and the sealed lift beyond the boss.

lettering_units.text: If it reaches center, the bridge rolls.
Then I turn the head. You read the legs.

panels.beat: Mira locks her rear boot behind a crossbar and forms the Bastion Lancer T-silhouette.
Belljaw launches right-to-left and punches one foreclaw through a bridge plank.
The broken plank flips into the void and the intact anchor jerks upward under transferred load.
Mira plants shield and spear with hands, grip, and footing unobstructed.
Belljaw's jaw strikes Mira's shield wedge at one clear point; her planted boot skids but holds.
Belljaw clamps Mira's Dark-Teal Spear below the head instead of recoiling.
Belljaw wrenches the captured spear; Mira rotates with it to preserve her wrists and weapon.
Elian reaches past Mira's right shoulder and begins a deliberate jaw-to-ankle Fault Sight scan.
Fault Sight reveals one hairline near-ankle stress seam under the jaw load.

lettering_units.text: FAULT SIGHT I · ACTIVE · QI 31 → 19 · COST 12 · ONE VERIFIED STRESS LINE · 6s · COOLDOWN 20s

panels.beat: The load path from jaw through shoulder to ankle remains visible for six seconds.
Mira gives Elian four useful seconds while her forearms tremble under Belljaw's load.
Elian slides left-to-right beneath the jaw using the chain rail as one step toward the ankle.
Belljaw's free forelimb folds at an unexpected second joint and rotates toward Elian.
The forelimb backhands Elian before his Hooked Shortblade reaches the seam; his body flies toward a hanging chain.
Elian's left ribs hit a hanging chain and his breath leaves in one white burst.
Elian catches the chain; his tethered blade hangs safely while the Ledger confirms damage and Cracked Rib.

lettering_units.text: HP 44 → 22 · INJURY: CRACKED RIB · SOURCE: BELLJAW FORELIMB IMPACT

panels.beat: Elian hangs against a broad void guarding the left rib as the collarbone fissure closes.
Mira holds Belljaw and orders Elian not to turn the injury into a plan.

lettering_units.text: Do not turn that hit into a plan.

panels.beat: Elian's attempted inhale lights the collarbone circuit, which folds inward and dies.
Elian's fingers find the unique Spark Talisman while both Iron Seals remain locked behind it.
Mira identifies the talisman as the Chainworks exit plan; Elian chooses to spend it without claiming her permission.

lettering_units.text: That gets us back through Chainworks.
Only if you can let go.
I didn't tell you to spend it.

panels.beat: Elian crushes the Spark Talisman; heat enters only his collarbone circuit while both Iron Seals remain untouched.

lettering_units.text: SPARK TALISMAN · TEMPERED · QUANTITY 1 → 0 · QI 19 → 33 · RESTORE 14 · VOLUNTARY CATALYST

panels.beat: Elian inhales toward the right collarbone and opens one thin ember fissure.
Pressure drops collarbone to sternum, buckles around the cracked rib, then exits the diaphragm at a 30-Qi cost.
Two restrained breath pulses stabilize Elian's collarbone fissure as Breath Seed II opens and Fault Step becomes compatible.

lettering_units.text: BREATH SEED I → II · BROKEN BREATH UNDER THREAT · QI MAX 40 → 48 · CURRENT 3 → 11 · FAULT STEP I COMPATIBLE

panels.beat: The glow recedes and one Overburn fleck damages Elian after the breakthrough.
Belljaw unloads the near ankle; the visible fault closes as Mira's spear begins to slip free.
Mira rotates with the wrench, drops shield under jaw, and plants the spear butt to load the ankle once.
Elian recognizes that Mira's planted line recreates the verified ankle fault.
Elian activates Fault Step along the verified structural line; movement is acceleration, not teleportation.

lettering_units.text: FAULT STEP I · ACTIVE · QI 11 → 3 · COST 8 · ONE BURST ALONG VERIFIED FAULT · COOLDOWN 8s

panels.beat: Mira drives left-to-right while Elian launches bottom-to-top; both vectors converge on the orange ankle seam.
Hooked Shortblade and Mira's redirected jaw load split the ankle plate at one clear point.
Belljaw folds and crashes away from the intact anchor while Elian lands guarding his rib; Overburn ticks a second time.
Mira keeps the spear on Belljaw until the jaw seam goes dark; Elian watches the forelimb remain still.
A Rare Cinder-Key rests between two broken ankle plates beside Elian's unsteady knee and Mira's boot.
The Ledger verifies boss defeat, one intact anchor, quest completion, 85 XP, Level 4, and the Cinder-Key drop.

lettering_units.text: BELLJAW WARDEN DEFEATED · BRIDGE ANCHOR 1 INTACT · QUEST COMPLETED
KILL SHARE +85 XP · LV 3 60/100 → LV 4 45/140 · HP MAX 52 → 56 · ATTRIBUTE POINT +1

panels.beat: Mira binds Elian's cracked left rib with his coat lining and checks hands and breath without joking.

lettering_units.text: Can you feel both hands? Any blood when you breathe?
Good. You don't get a third answer.

panels.beat: A pulse enters the intact anchor and travels upward toward the city while the clean shear face catches Elian's eye again.
The Cinder-Key displays Kiln Appraiser and Faultline Adept without selection as the far lift opens and Choose the Crack is offered.

lettering_units.text: CHOOSE THE CRACK · OFFERED · SELECT A CLASS PATH · REACH THE HOLLOW MERIDIAN CROWN · BELL REGENT ASCENT ACTIVE
Choose after the room stops moving.

panels.beat: Mira leads Elian into the lift at her pace; his injured side is protected and the Cinder-Key remains unbound in his open hand.
